props.text: PUMP.fun token (Solana) — bullish technical + fundamental thesis. D1 trending along 7d rvwap, post-breakout retest consolidation at 365d rvwap + ATH avwap (Aug 20/22), left bear market → bull market. Holding monthly VAH, finding base at 7d rvwap. Fundamental: top-3 protocol by user count/revenue/social, money-printing machine. Tactic: buy every dip.
